description: OSCAT Basic 3.3.5.0 whole-library export from CODESYS 3 (user provided)

supplement.reason: The CODESYS 3 export contains the POUs but not the DUT and global variable list objects (STRING_LENGTH, LIST_LENGTH, MATH, SETUP, ... are used but not declared). The CODESYS 2.3 export of the same release 3.35 contains them; only types and global variables the CODESYS 3 export lacks are taken.
